purpose: reduce a chosen piece of debt safely, in small steps that keep behavior unchanged and leave the code easier to change
entry_criteria: The debt item is chosen and has an owner (stage 76)
Tests cover the area or can be added first
The change can ship in small steps
procedure: State the outcome that proves the debt is paid, such as a removed module or a lower defect rate.
Add characterization tests around current behavior before touching the code.
Refactor in small commits that each keep the tests green; do not mix in new features.
Release behind a flag or in stages when the area is critical, and watch the metrics after each release.
Delete the old code and unused configuration once nothing uses them.
Close the register entry with the evidence and note anything new discovered.
acceptance_criteria: Behavior is unchanged by the characterization tests
No unrelated features are in the change

validation.expect: characterization and existing tests pass at every commit

failure_modes.response: Revert the step and make it smaller

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A hand-written date parser causes repeated bugs. Tests pin its current outputs, calls are moved to the standard library in five small commits, and the parser file is deleted.
